name: HTS Labs Pregnancy Calculator
author: HTS Labs

sections.description:
HTS Labs Pregnancy Calculator adds a responsive calculator that estimates:

  • estimated due date
  • current gestational age
  • estimated conception date
  • estimated fertility window

The free edition focuses on the first day of the last menstrual period (LMP) method only.

Features

  • LMP-based pregnancy due date calculation
  • custom in-plugin calendar date picker
  • shortcode support: [pddc_due_date]
  • tabbed admin settings UI
  • layout and styling controls for the main calculator/result cards
  • adjustable colors and disclaimer text
  • responsive frontend layout
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/hts-labs-pregnancy-calculator directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Due Date Calculator in the WordPress admin menu to configure the calculator.
  4. Add the shortcode [pddc_due_date] to any page or post.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin include the week tracker?

No. This free edition includes the LMP-based due date calculator only.

Can I change the styling?

Yes. The plugin includes simplified layout and design settings for the free edition.

Does this plugin require an external service?

No. The free calculator works entirely inside WordPress.
